scope: Public GRD product metadata; no EE request, imagery processing, raster download, detector output or review data
cross_catalogue_match_rule: Compare first 8 underscore-delimited Sentinel product fields: platform, mode, GRD resolution, product/polarization, acquisition start, acquisition stop, absolute orbit, hexadecimal datatake. CDSE COG counterparts have different trailing checksum/COG suffix and are not asserted byte-identical to ASF original GRD products.
limitations: Public ASF original GRD and CDSE COG counterparts independently corroborate acquisition metadata. Presence of these exact items in Earth Engine COPERNICUS/S1_GRD remains unverified.
Footprints enclose all four analysis-grid corners, which supports AOI catalog coverage; per-pixel validity under production masks and >=70% common valid coverage have not been measured.
Catalog providers use their own temporal query semantics; replay must apply explicit UTC start>=union_start and start<union_end and exact case date boundaries.
A/B platform mixing is retained because production radar grouping uses relative orbit/pass only.
No whole-AOI quiet label is supported by this metadata audit.

query.spatial_filter: Catalog intersection with transformed corners of the snapped production grid. All four corners additionally checked inside both providers product footprints; this is metadata coverage only.
query.product_scope: Sentinel-1A/B GRD at ASF and sentinel-1-grd at CDSE; not an Earth Engine raw collection inventory.

availability_status: independently_verified_public_metadata; Earth Engine inventory and pixel validity unverified
identity_note: ASF original GRD product IDs are retained exactly. CDSE COG products match acquisition identity through datatake (first eight filename fields), but trailing checksum differs. No claim of equal product bytes, equal processing or exact EE ingestion.
